title: Unforgettable Earthy Turkish Chickpeas Kofte
description: A festive Turkish dish featuring chickpeas, render-fat, and earthy flavors, made into snappy kofte, low-sodium-friendly and perfect for any occasion. This dish is a delightful blend of textures and tastes.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mash the chickpeas using a fork or a potato masher until they are mostly smooth.
Add the rendered lamb fat, chopped onion, minced garlic, chopped parsley, paprika, cumin, salt-free seasoning blend, and black pepper to the bowl with the chickpeas.
Mix everything together until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Stir in the whole wheat breadcrumbs.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small kofte, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Place the kofte on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the kofte in the preheated oven for 18 minutes, flipping them halfway through.
Remove the kofte from the oven and let them cool on the baking sheet for a few minutes.
Serve the kofte hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
